description: Fraud intelligence for any IPv4 or IPv6 address: a 0-100 fraud score, risk band, and whether it is a VPN, proxy, Tor node, relay, datacenter host or mobile connection. Also returns the owning network (ASN, ISP, organisation), geolocation, reverse DNS, abuse history and how much of its /24 subnet is flagged. Free, no key. Use it before trusting a signup, a checkout or an API caller.

ips.description: IPv4 or IPv6 addresses. One is the common case.
